pr_title: Fix New Tree References Null Stylebox
pr_body:
Creating a new Tree and attempting to read `get_column_width(0)` will crash Godot because of a null reference to cache StyleBox

Add an `is_valid` check for the StyleBox will let the script run normally

Fix #46005

comments:
hi, I'd like to tackle this issue but I want to clarify how to proceed.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/3ddab1c9d171dc69a3ebf1ad747dfaea19e49339/scene/gui/tree.cpp#L3366-L3368

get_column_with() already has an ERR_FAIL_INDEX_V for out of bounds so should I just include another exception for not having a root? or just return 0?
I think it should also FAIL and return -1.
You should validate a `Ref<T>` with `ref.is_valid()` before dereferencing it, otherwise you can get a null pointer dereference (which is the case here and triggers a crash).

I can confirm this on `3.2` Git 08898e97a.

```gdscript
extends Control

func _ready():
	var tree = Tree.new()
	var root = tree.create_item()
	print(tree.get_column_width(0))  # This line crashes.
```
